An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''commander''' was present aboard the [[M-Class Imperial Attack Transport]] ''[[Regina Cayli]]'' during its mission to [[New Bakstre]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Regina" />

==Behind the scenes==
The commander was mentioned in the roleplaying adventure "[[Regina Cayli (adventure)|Regina Cayli]]," first published in [[1987]]'s [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']] by [[West End Games]]. In [[1994]], it was subsequently reprinted in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.
